subject: HarborTrust evaluation MAP — security, archival & DPA redline path
messages:
From: Erin Cole <erin.cole@harbortrust.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Schmidt <markus.schmidt@harbortrust.com>
Date: 2028-09-12T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + security/onboarding questions for evaluation

Connor — thanks for the demo last week. HarborTrust wants to lock the MAP and get the evaluation timeline in motion so we can review SOC 2 evidence and the DPA before Q4 procurement. Two quick asks to start: 

1) Do you have a copy of your most recent SOC 2 Type II (or a redacted summary) and an inventory of SIG/CAIQ controls you cover?
2) We need a proposed MAP with clear gating checkpoints for: SOC 2 verification, SIG questionnaire turnaround, DPA redline review, and a data retention/archival policy (we have strict 7-year archival for certain logs).

Can you share a draft MAP + timeline (2–3 week evaluation preferred) and indicate who on your side will own evidence intake?

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30m call if that helps.

— Erin
Erin Cole
Director, Procurement | HarborTrust
Erin.Cole@harbortrust.com
+1 415-555-0199

Attachments: none

From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
To: Erin Cole <erin.cole@harbortrust.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-09-12T12:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + security/onboarding questions for evaluation

Hi Erin — really appreciate the clear asks. 

Attached is a proposed MAP spreadsheet (proposed_MAP_harbortrust_v1.xlsx) and our latest SOC 2 Type II attestation (redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2028.pdf). Highlights from the MAP:
- Kickoff + evidence intake (Day 0–2): connect HarborTrust security contacts to our intake form and SSO artifact bucket. Owner: Connor (Redwood) / Erin (HarborTrust).
- SIG/CAIQ sprint (Day 3–7): Redwood will pre-fill controls we cover; HarborTrust to review and flag gaps. Owner: Neha for responses.
- DPA redline window (Day 8–12): legal swaps & redlines; we can do tracked changes in Docx. Owner: Laura to coordinate.
- SOC 2 validation (Day 10–14): we’ll confirm scope artifacts and provide SOC 2 attestation + control evidence stubs.
- Final decision & procurement handoff (Day 15–21).

Two specific notes on retention/archival and DPA: 
1) Data retention: Our default logs/telemetry retention is 90 days hot, 2 years cold; we offer long-term archival (encrypted, write-once) for regulated workloads — pricing and SLA vary. For HarborTrust, we propose an archival lane: 7-year WORM for audit logs (separate export subscription).
2) DPA: We can accept most commercial DPA asks; HarborTrust exceptions (KMS escrow, on-prem key escrow) need legal review. I’ve asked Laura to take point on redlines — she’s CC'd.

If helpful I can schedule a 30m sync after you review the MAP. Next steps: please confirm evidence owners and any non-standard retention requirements so we can mark them in the MAP.

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
connor@redwood.com | +1 206-555-0112

Attachments: proposed_MAP_harbortrust_v1.xlsx, redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2028.pdf

From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-09-12T12:07:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: HarborTrust evaluation MAP — security, archival & DPA redline path

Internal note — forwarding HarborTrust asks and the MAP I just sent. Key asks for our side: 
- Neha: prepare SIG/CAIQ pre-fill and mark controls requiring operational evidence (list S3 bucket paths + sample reports).
- Laura: review the DPA redline lane; HarborTrust tends to press for longer retention and KMS controls. Prepare a short legal stance doc (1 page) we can include in the MAP.

I also flagged the 7-year archival requirement — we should confirm if that is for audit logs only or data subject content (they said "certain logs"). If it's content, that changes product/price.

Will loop back once you both have a quick read.

— Connor

From: HarborTrust Legal <legal@harbortrust.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Cc: Erin Cole <erin.cole@harbortrust.com>, Markus Schmidt <markus.schmidt@harbortrust.com>
Date: 2028-09-14T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: HarborTrust comments: DPA redlines + retention clarification

Connor — attaching our initial DPA redlines (HarborTrust_DPA_redlines_v1.docx). Two clarifications up front: 

1) Retention: redlines assume 7-year retention for audit logs and a maximum of 2 years for user-generated content unless otherwise contractually required. If Redwood's archival plan can guarantee WORM + SAS-based export for audit copies, please indicate in MAP.
2) KMS: HarborTrust prefers customer-managed keys for a subset of data (audit exports). If this is not feasible in hosted mode, note the dedicated/private deployment option and cost delta.

We also noted a few SOC-related control evidence gaps in the SIG draft (control ID A.4.3 — incident postmortem retention) — please advise how Redwood can produce past incident postmortems (redacted).

We'd like to keep the MAP timeline tight — target acceptance by 2028-09-19 so procurement can start negotiations.

Best,
HarborTrust Legal
(attachment: HarborTrust_DPA_redlines_v1.docx)

From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
To: Erin Cole <erin.cole@harbortrust.com>, Markus Schmidt <markus.schmidt@harbortrust.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-09-15T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: HarborTrust evaluation MAP — security, archival & DPA redline path

Erin / Markus — thanks for the redlines and the retention clarity. Summary and next steps from Redwood's side: 

1) SOC 2 / SIG evidence: Neha will upload a pre-filled SIG workbook and a small evidence bundle (control mappings + redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2028.pdf). For past incident postmortems we can provide redacted summaries for the last 18 months — acceptable?
2) Retention: We can offer a 7-year WORM archival lane for audit logs as an add-on export subscription; pricing delta will be noted in the MAP. We confirm user content default 2-year archival unless the contract requires longer — we marked an exception path.
3) KMS: Customer-managed key support is available on our Dedicated and Private deployment tiers; for Hosted we offer envelope encryption with HSM-backed keys. Laura will propose a short contract clause and a limited carve-out for audit-export keys.
4) DPA redlines: Laura will produce a redline response by EOD 2028-09-17.

Proposed acceptance milestone: HarborTrust confirms MAP + one round of DPA revisions by 2028-09-19; Redwood to deliver final procurement packet (SLA, pricing for archival lane) by 2028-09-21. 

Connor will schedule a 30m alignment call for 2028-09-16 10:00 PT unless you prefer another slot. Please confirm.

Thanks — Connor
Connor O'Brien
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
connor@redwood.com | +1 206-555-0112

Attachments referenced: HarborTrust_DPA_redlines_v1.docx (attached by HarborTrust), proposed_MAP_harbortrust_v1.xlsx, redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2028.pdf
